I made it very clear that my phone number must never be kept on my child’s records, because if those records are requested my details could be exposed to my abusive ex-partner. The practice told me they understood the situation and had safeguards in place.

Previously, my email was listed with a note to contact me by email to arrange a call if needed. When booking an appointment, I repeated explicit instructions not to put my number on their system under any circumstances. I was assured it would only be used for the consultation request, deleted afterwards, and that I didn’t need to worry.

This week I discovered they ignored my instructions, kept my number on their system for months, and even deleted my email address. That is unacceptable.

I am now contacting the Information Commissioner to make a formal complaint.
